repo_model.summary: This repository is a RelBench generic-search candidate workspace: main.py loads a task from the sanitized cache and emits baseline predictions, while kapso_datasets provides contract-safe helpers and kapso_evaluation runs isolated validation, scoring, and archival.

entrypoints.how_to_run: python main.py --debug for the cheap pipeline check; python main.py for the full run.

where_to_edit.role: Primary solution entrypoint; replace the seeded trivial prediction logic while preserving task loading, output filenames, and prediction shapes.

evidence.description: Describes the current output as trivial predictions.
Explicitly instructs replacing the baseline with a real solution.
Writes validation predictions in normal mode.

where_to_edit.role: Reusable task-loading, prediction-saving, temporal-safety, and MAP@K helper module.

evidence.description: Recommends importing the helpers from main.py.

where_to_edit.role: Immutable evaluation pipeline; do not reimplement or modify it for model changes.

evidence.description: Identifies grader.py as the complete immutable scoring pipeline.
States that the grader already performs the required evaluation work.
Instructs not to reimplement the evaluation pipeline.

claims.statement: The candidate entrypoint reads dataset/task identity from environment variables, loads the RelBench task with download=False, counts validation and test rows, and detects rolling mode when the cached validation table is empty.

evidence.description: Documents empty validation tables in rolling snapshots.
Sets validation row count and rolling mode.

claims.statement: The baseline generates family-specific trivial predictions: ranked integer IDs for recommendation, 0.5 probabilities for binary classification, uniform class scores for multiclass classification, and the training-target median for other task types.

evidence.description: Computes the training target median for the fallback.

claims.statement: kapso_datasets.common.load_task builds a TaskContext containing the dataset, task, database, labeled train/validation tables, unlabeled test table, and target-column accessor; it uses the RelBench database cutoff selected by upto_test_timestamp.

evidence.description: Documents test seed IDs and timestamps.
Defines task loading and its timestamp-cutoff option.
Constructs the database with the selected cutoff.

claims.statement: The immutable grader runs main.py in an isolated child subprocess, passes the run output directory through KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR, validates predictions, computes official RelBench validation metrics, and requires the configured primary metric.

evidence.description: Builds the main.py command for each fidelity.
Injects KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR into the child environment.
Checks that the configured primary metric exists.

claims.statement: Full-fidelity runs are archived with prediction files, private validation metrics, a selection status record, and a snapshot of candidate code; the manifest records the validation score and archive run.

evidence.description: Copies validation and test predictions into the archive.
Uses the primary validation metric as the manifest score.
Persists the manifest alongside the archive.

claims.statement: Every run, including debug, must produce val_predictions.npy and test_predictions.npy under KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR, with rows positionally aligned to the task validation and test tables; validation predictions must be out-of-sample.

evidence.description: States when the harness loads prediction files.
Requires both files after every run and positional alignment.
Requires validation predictions to be out-of-sample.

claims.statement: Required prediction formats are binary float probabilities of shape (N,) in [0,1], regression floats of shape (N,), multiclass float scores of shape (N,C), and recommendation integer rankings of shape (N,K) containing distinct destination IDs in [0,num_dst).

evidence.description: Defines all task-family shapes, dtypes, and value constraints.
Checks recommendation shape and integer dtype.

claims.statement: Data must come from the sanitized, read-only RelBench cache through download=False; test labels are absent and must not be probed.

evidence.description: Requires the RelBench API with download=False.
Describes the cache as sanitized/read-only and test labels as absent.

claims.statement: The search score of record is the configured official validation primary metric; test metrics are private and are not available during the search loop.

evidence.description: Defines the official validation primary metric as the search score.
States that test metrics are private.
Places the configured primary validation metric in the manifest score.

claims.statement: Run python main.py --debug for the fast pipeline check and python main.py for the full training run; fast and full both score the complete validation split rather than subsampling validation rows.

evidence.description: Explains that evaluation cost is in candidate training.
States that fast and full score the complete validation split.

claims.statement: After writing predictions, run python kapso_datasets/check_predictions.py; successful validation prints an OK line for each split followed by all checks passed.

evidence.description: Checks both validation and test splits.

claims.statement: An official grader run reports OFFICIAL VALIDATION METRICS and emits a KAPSO_EVAL_MANIFEST containing the fidelity, item counts, primary score, and archived run identifier.

In rolling evaluation, each snapshot has an empty validation table, so main.py intentionally skips val_predictions.npy and writes only the current tick's test predictions; the grader later assembles tick outputs into the official validation and test vectors by snapshot indices.

evidence.description: Documents empty validation tables in rolling snapshots.
Derives rolling mode from zero validation rows.
Skips validation output in rolling mode.
Always writes the tick's test predictions.
Defines one candidate invocation per rolling tick.
Requires test predictions for each tick.

claims.statement: load_task defaults to database rows up to the test timestamp; autocomplete tasks must explicitly pass upto_test_timestamp=False when post-test-cutoff entity rows are needed as inputs.

evidence.description: Explains that post-cutoff targets are blanked.
Passes the cutoff choice to dataset.get_db.

claims.statement: The self-checker warns rather than fails for recommendation IDs outside the destination range or duplicate IDs, even though the evaluation contract requires valid distinct destination rankings.

evidence.description: Requires distinct recommendation IDs in range.
Out-of-range recommendation IDs produce a warning.
Duplicate recommendation IDs produce a warning.

claims.statement: The official grader's load_and_score checks that both prediction files exist but applies detailed shape and finite-value validation only to validation predictions; use check_predictions.py to validate both splits before submission.

evidence.description: Checks file existence for both splits.
Validates recommendation shape and dtype for validation predictions.
Validates validation length and finiteness for non-recommendation tasks.
The standalone checker iterates over both splits.

claims.statement: The candidate directly depends on numpy and RelBench's base/task APIs, and the evaluation suite expects Python with relbench and numpy installed.

evidence.description: States that Python with relbench and numpy is sufficient.

claims.statement: The handler supplies RELBENCH_DATASET, RELBENCH_TASK, RELBENCH_PRIMARY_METRIC, RELBENCH_CACHE_DIR, timeout variables, and KAPSO_SHARED_CACHE_DIR; the candidate receives KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR for its prediction outputs.
Cache access is local and non-downloading: common helpers create a shared cache directory when needed, while dataset/task loading explicitly uses download=False.

evidence.description: Defines the shared cache directory helper.

book.summary: This repository is a RelBench generic-search candidate workspace: main.py loads a task from the sanitized cache and emits baseline predictions, while kapso_datasets provides contract-safe helpers and kapso_evaluation runs isolated validation, scoring, and archival.

toc.title: Architecture
toc.one_liner: RelBench task loading flows into task-family-specific prediction generation, contract validation, official validation scoring, and full-run archival.

toc.title: Testing
toc.one_liner: Use debug/full harness runs and the prediction checker to validate execution, output contracts, and official validation scoring.

toc.title: Gotchas
toc.one_liner: Rolling snapshots, timestamp cutoffs, and asymmetric checker/grader validation can cause otherwise surprising behavior.

toc.title: Dependencies
toc.one_liner: Runtime behavior depends on Python with numpy and relbench plus handler-provided cache, task, metric, and output environment variables.
